title: Paul Mellon's walking stick

tellings.quote: I was told it was Paul Melon's washing stick.

plain: A former presidential advisor named Harold Malmgren, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast about the UFO material he says he handled, mentions a walking stick in Virginia. Malmgren says he was told it belonged to a man named Paul Mellon. He does not say much more, but it comes up as one of the objects and links in his account.
